comment: Two C-N and one ether cross-link on the core peptide WYWY

reactions.description: SspP catalyzes dual C–N cross-links alongside an aryl ether linkage within the core WYWY motif

SspP installs two C–N linkages (Trp1-C to backbone-N; Trp1-C to Trp3-N) and one aryl ether linkage (Tyr2-C to Tyr4-O) on the core motif WYWY of precursor peptide SspA. The cross-linked mature product Spectabin, retains N-terminal Lysine residue which undergoes spontaneous cyclization, incorporating a methylene carbon to bridge its amine group to the indole-N of Trp1. SspA: MRRILSSKNRPARKWYWY
